## Overview

A cluster of settlements in the northeast of Kythoria that forms the economic backbone of the mortal races. This area contains the continent's royal mint and its greatest known mines for precious metals and gemstones.

## Geography & Structure

The cluster consists of **one major settlement and three minor ones**, plus two smaller nearby settlements that assist in exporting currency. This was the site of the royal mint before the monster invasion, and after the reconquering, production resumed here.

## Economy

The northeast settlement cluster is the single most economically vital area in the recovered territories:

- **Minting**: Produces the currency used across all mortal territories  -  copper, silver, gold, and platinum pieces
- **Mining**: The greatest known mines for precious metals and gemstones are located here
- **Trade**: Exports precious metals, gemstones, and minted currency to the rest of the continent

Operations are managed by the **Miners' & Prospectors' Guild** with strict quotas and safety regulations.

## Notable Locations

- **The Royal Mint**: Produces all standard currency for the mortal races
- **The Great Mines**: The largest known deposits of gold, silver, platinum, and gemstones
- **The Thormvuld Ancestral Holdings**: The dwarven arcane engineering family originates here, with workshops south of the main settlement
